Package io.webagent4j.crawler

package io.webagent4j.crawler
The deterministic, sequential HTTP crawler engine: a java.net.http.HttpClient fetcher, jsoup link extraction, a breadth-first frontier, URL normalization/deduplication/scope policy, and redirect/retry handling - no browser, no JavaScript execution.

HttpCrawler is the only implementation of ICrawler (webagent4j-crawler-api). It tracks two identity sets deliberately kept separate: discovery identity (seeds and HTML links only) drives CrawlStatistics#discoveredUrls(), while fetch identity (every real HTTP request, including each redirect hop) drives fetchedUrls() and is exactly what CrawlRequest#maxPages() bounds, claimed immediately before every real request through one central gate.

This package cannot depend on Playwright, any browser backend, or an AI/LLM library - enforced by dedicated ArchUnit rules. See docs/http-crawler.md for the full traversal pipeline and the precise meaning of every CrawlFailureType.

  • Class
    Description
    DefaultUrlNormalizer
    Deterministic IUrlNormalizer: lowercases scheme and host, drops the fragment, drops a default port (:80 for http, :443 for https), resolves ./ .. path segments (URI.normalize()), maps an empty path to "/", and applies a fixed QueryParameterPolicy - never reordering surviving query parameters or re-encoding anything, so already-valid percent-encoding is never corrupted.
    ExtractedLink
    One navigation link exactly as extracted from HTML, before any crawl scope/policy decision - the raw material HttpCrawler turns into a DiscoveredLink once it knows whether the link is allowed.
    HostScopePolicy
    Default ICrawlScopePolicy: checks scheme, then host/domain scope, then URL filters, in that order - the first failing check determines the rejection reason.
    HttpCrawler
    Deterministic, sequential HTTP crawler.
    HttpFetchRequest
    Immutable GET request for one IHttpFetcher.fetch(HttpFetchRequest) call - one HTTP round trip, never a redirect-following sequence: the caller (the crawl engine) decides whether and how to follow a redirect target, so it can apply crawl scope to it first.
    HttpFetchResult
    Immutable result of one successfully-completed HTTP round trip - a response was received and its body fully read within the request's byte limit.
    IHtmlLinkExtractor
    Extracts navigation links, the document title, and the declared canonical URL from one HTML document.
    IHttpFetcher
    Backend-neutral single-hop HTTP fetch abstraction.
    JavaHttpFetcher
    IHttpFetcher backed by java.net.http.HttpClient.
    JsoupHtmlLinkExtractor
    IHtmlLinkExtractor backed by jsoup, a real, malformed- HTML-tolerant parser - never a regular expression.
    LinkExtractionResult
    Everything IHtmlLinkExtractor extracts from one HTML document.
    ResponseTooLargeException
    A response body exceeded its request's maxResponseBytes while being read.
